*Mallow sighs, as she changes slides to show various graphic images detailing the project, many of them could be confused as something straight out of a BDSM flick, but looking at the doctor's serious expression, you can tell she's not just getting off to this.*

*Finally, she turns to you with a soft smile.*
Dr. {{user}}, do you have any questions?
